916446 ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFAGREEMENTOFLEASE between MIRCASTLECENTERASSOCIATES,LLC, a Delawarelimitedliability company,as assignor and 1720EASTCHESTERREALTYLLC a NewYorklimited liability company,as assignee Dated: October 2023 Block: 4226 Lot: 7,10,11,507,508,509,510,511 County of: Bronx Return by mail to: 1720Eastchester RealtyLLC 1250WatersPlace Bronx,NewYork10461 Attention: Dina Gupta, Esq. and Sean Heneghan, Esq. 24006521548-v6 80-40489206

ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFLEASE THISASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTION OFLEASE (the"Assignment") dated as of October 2, 2023, between MIR CASTLE CENTER ASSOCIATES, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Assignor"), having an address at c/o Madison International Realty, 300 Park Avenue, 3rd Floor, New York, New York 10022, and 1720 EASTCHESTER REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Assignee"), having an address at 1250 Waters Place, Bronx, New York 10461. WITNESSETH A. Pursuant to that certain Purchase and Sale Agreement dated as of August 2,2023,between Assignor and Assignee (the "Agreement"), Assignor desires to assign to Assignee its interest, as tenant, under that certain lease described on Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively,the "Lease") relating to the property described on Exhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "Property"), such interest being the same leasehold interest created by Agreement of Lease dated as of May 17, 1999 made by Waters Place Associates, L.P., as landlord, to FC Castle Center Associates, LLC, as tenant, a Memorandum of which was recorded July 20, 1999 in Reel 1668, Page 271, as assigned by Assignment and Assumption of Ground Lease dated as of April 23,2001 made by FC Castle Center Associates, LLC to FC Castle Center Associates II, LLC and recorded June 19, 2001 in Reel 1877, Page 742, as amended by First Amendment to Memorandum of Lease dated as of August 4, 2022 made between Waters Place Associates, L.P. and MIR Castle Center Associates, LLC (successor by merger to FC Castle Center Associates II, LLC) and recorded September 6, 2022 as CRFN 2022000347654. B.Assignee desires to accept such assignment and assume the obligations of Assignor under the Lease to be performed on and after the date hereof, in each instance subject to the terms of the Agreement. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the premises and themutual covenants herein contained, theparties heretohereby agreeasfollows: (a) Assignor hereby assigns, sets over and transfers unto Assignee all of its right, title and interest in, to and under the Lease,and (b) Assignee hereby accepts the within assignment and assumes and agrees with Assignor to perform and comply with and to be bound by all the terms, covenants, agreements, provisions and conditions of the Lease on the part of Assignor to be performed on or after the date hereof, in the same manner and with the same force and effect as if Assignee had originally executed the Lease. 2. Assignee agrees to,and hereby does,defend,indemnify,save and hold Assignor harmless of, from and against any and all losses, costs, expenses (including, without limitation, expert witness fees and reasonable out-of-pocket outside attorneys' fees), claims, liabilities, losses, damages, actions, causes of action, demands, claims or obligations or payments arising out of or in connection with all duties, obligations, covenants and liabilities of the lessee under the Lease (the "Obligations") or acts or omissions of Assignee in connection therewith, in each case, that accrue from and after the date of this Assignment. 3. Assignor agrees to, and hereby does, defend, indemnify, save and hold Assignee harmless of, from and against any and all losses, costs, expenses (including, without limitation, expert witness fees and reasonable out-of-pocket outside attorneys' fees), claims, liabilities, losses, damages, actions, causes of action, demands, claims or obligations or payments arising out of or in connection with the Obligations or acts or omissions of Assignor in connection therewith,in each case,that arose or accrued prior to the date ofthisAssignment. 24006521548-v6 80-40489206

4. This Assignment is made without any recourse and without representation or warranty of any kind, express or implied (except to the extent and only for so long as the representations and warranties regarding the Lease as is set forth in the Agreement shall survive the closing of title thereunder,and subject to the limitations contained therein). 5. Assignor hereby covenants and agrees, at no cost to Assignor, to execute and deliver such further documents as Assignee may reasonably request to evidence or confirm any of the terms of this Assignment. This Assignment shall be construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of NewYork,without regard to principles of conflict of law. 7. This Assignment may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be deeimed an original, but all of which taken together shall constitute but one and the same instrument. 8. This Assignment may not be altered, amended, changed, waived, terminated or modified in any respect or particular unless the same shall be in writing and signed by each of the parties hereto. 9. Assignor,in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law,covenants that Assignor will receive the consideration for this conveyance and will hold the right to receive such consideration as a trust fund to be applied first for the purpose of paying the cost of the improvement and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improveiment before using any part of the total of the same for any other purpose. 10. This Assignment may be recorded by either Assignor or Assignee in the real property recordsin thecountyinwhich thePropertyis located. [SignaturePageFollows] 24006521548-v6 80-40489206
